changelog: Subtitle burn-in rejects HTTPS-to-HTTP redirect downgrades and strips Cookie, Authorization, Proxy-Authorization, Origin, and Referer when a redirect changes origin
Subtitle burn-in bounds parsed subtitle work to 2,000 cues, 600 characters per cue, and 100,000 rendered-text characters while removing control and bidirectional override characters
Subtitle burn-in renders at most the two most recent overlapping cues and caps the composed caption frame at 1,200 characters to keep Media3 overlay work bounded
message: CS3M v664 — bounded subtitle burn-in redirects and rendering
